statements.t: For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the net impact on earnings related to the aforementioned tariffs was approximately $25 million and we expect a continuing impact from tariffs in future periods.
Further, certain of these recoveries may include government-issued credits and there is uncertainty about whether we will be able to effectively monetize such credits.
For the full year 2026, we anticipate the impact on earnings of these tariffs to be approximately $20 million to $25 million after mitigation actions and estimated customer recoveries.
We continue to work with customers and suppliers in our effort to protect continuity of supply as we expect these challenges to continue in 2026.
In 2026, we expect to incur approximately $90 million to $110 million of total restructuring charges.
In addition, we expect to incur approximately $100 million to $115 million of integration costs in 2026 associated with the Business Combination.
We do not expect to incur further acquisition-related costs.
We expect our interest expense for the full year 2026 to be approximately $350 million to $360 million.
For the full year 2026, we expect restructuring payments in cash flows from operating activities to be approximately $135 million to $150 million.

In addition, for the full year 2026, we expect integration payments in cash flows from operating activities to be approximately $85 million to $100 million in connection with the Business Combination.
We do not expect any additional acquisition-related payments.
We expect our capital spending in 2026 to be approximately 4% of sales.

We intend to use the availability of long-term financing under the Senior Secured Credit Facilities to refinance any current maturities related to such debt agreements that are not otherwise refinanced on a long-term basis in their local markets, except where otherwise reclassified to Current portion of long-term debt on our Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheet.
We intend to use the remaining proceeds of the Notes for general corporate purposes, which may include, among other things, repayment of other outstanding indebtedness.

Although the outcome of these matters cannot be predicted with certainty, at this time we do not believe that any of these matters, individually or in the aggregate, will have a material adverse effect on our results of operations, financial condition or cash flows.
We will continue to closely monitor our environmental conditions to ensure that we are in compliance with all laws, regulations and ordinances.

We have made, and anticipate continuing to make, capital and other expenditures (including recurring administrative costs) to comply with environmental requirements at our current and former facilities.
